verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page claims 'Instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow, plus run scenarios to plan ahead' and cash-flow scenario modeling, indicating some AI-driven insight capability, but this is a single thin marketing mention with no product screenshots, feature depth, or independent/hands-on corroboration of AI-generated insights actually working inside the product. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the AI insight feature, examples of actual AI-generated suggestions, and independent user reports confirming the AI answers work as described.
